Multiple Docker containers run in the example stack: public proxy, review pipeline, signal tracker, demo site, and dashboard. Several custom networks exist, and egress NAT must be configured consistently.
Chat integration: socket mode enabled, allowlist policy active, channel bindings configured, and explicit channel allowlist required.
MemoryService: example memory endpoint, v1.4.0, medium-sized main DB, thousands of active memories, async store <100ms, embed worker backfills every 5min.
login protection: per-rule allowlist plus basic and repeat-offender protection rules. If a trusted client changes network, update config and runtime allowlist together.
Several agent runtime scheduled jobs and MemoryService maintenance jobs are active. Some jobs have model overrides, so provider dependency and fallback behavior must be reviewed separately.
PublicProxy: reverse proxy inside the Docker network, SSL termination, standard web entrypoint. It is one of several containers in the example stack.
PM2: scheduled-report, digest-report, health-check process'leri. Node.js process manager olarak kullanılıyor.
demo agent: content-review steward agent for a review.example.invalid demo environment.
Embedder bileşeni llama-embedding.service içinde çalışır; example embedding port üzerinden embedding isteği alır, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B Q8_0 modeliyle 1024 boyutlu vektör üretir.
